caseNameFull: James F. Bishop, Administrator, etc. v. Frederick A. Delano, Receivers of the Wabash Railroad Company

opinions.text: October 11, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit denied. Mr. Fred W. Bentley for petitioner. Mr. Frederic D. McKenney and Mr. William Sherman Hay for respondents.
